findings: [INLINE + publicRead] Prior attempt-1 failure diagnosis and R3 normalizer repair: In attempt 1 on R2 tree 7a89671b88b8e9e879c24657a299adcf6b7fac1e, the no-default mori CLI and native_feature_boundary test binary compiled cleanly in 52.22s (failed-attempt-1/STDERR.log), and both test functions failed on their initial wrapped diagnostic checks (0 passed, 2 failed, exit 101 in 52.262193s; failed-attempt-1/STDOUT.log, RESULT.json) because Shell::report renders diagnostics via GraphicalTheme::unicode() at width <= 80 (render.rs, shell.rs), inserting a leading '│' box-drawing continuation gutter on wrapped lines. R3's line-oriented normalize_ws (R3-CHANGE.diff, native_feature_boundary.rs:74-94) trims leading indentation, skips empty lines, leaves the first non-empty line intact, and strips at most one leading '│' prefix on subsequent non-empty lines before whitespace-joining, while two pure literal assertions (lines 162-171) verify exact wrapped diagnostic normalization and retention of internal/secondary '│' characters without adding child invocations or test functions.

[INLINE + publicRead] Whole-file cfg gate and no-default dependency closure: candidate/crates/mori/tests/native_feature_boundary.rs begins with #![cfg(not(feature = "native"))] on line 1 before all imports, ensuring default/native builds select 0 tests in this file (which is not a pass for no-native availability), while --no-default-features excludes optional mori-backend, mori-ledger, futures, rand, and all midnight-* crates (candidate/crates/mori/Cargo.toml, confirmed by failed-attempt-1/STDERR.log compiling only non-native workspace crates).

[INLINE + publicRead] Faithfulness of 17 native/mixed routes across missing and populated-sentinel phases (34 planned child calls): Cross-checking candidate/crates/mori/src/commands/{mod,compile,compile_call,prepare_call,keygen_call,prove_call,verify_call,keygen_signed_call,prepare_signed_call,prove_signed_call,verify_signed_call,prove,verify,replay,inspect,simulate,intent,verify_intent}.rs confirms that under cfg(not(feature = "native")), all 13 pure native commands and all 4 mixed native-gated modes (inspect --target, simulate --trace --target, intent --profile moriarty-jubjub-owner-intent/1 --target --at, verify-intent --profile moriarty-jubjub-owner-intent/1 --target) return mori::command::native-unavailable (exit 1, empty stdout) prior to reading input files or creating output directories/files, including when agreement.mori contains the exact 497-byte final-LF VALID-CORE2.mori fixture.

[INLINE + publicRead] Faithfulness of 6 clap exit-2 and 4 argument-semantic exit-1 precedence cases (10 planned child calls): Cross-checking cli.rs and command Args definitions confirms the 6 clap cases (missing --out on compile, missing required flags on prove, --trace vs --logical-cap conflict on simulate, --resume vs --target conflict on simulate, --logical-cap vs --profile/--target conflict on verify-intent, global --quiet vs --verbose conflict) fail in clap parsing with exit 2 and no native-unavailable code; and the 4 semantic cases (simulate --trace missing --target, intent signed profile missing --at, intent signed profile missing --target, verify-intent signed profile missing --target) supply complete required ActionInput/authority/signature/at arguments to pass clap and trigger their exact pre-gate semantic errors with exit 1, empty stdout, and no native-unavailable code.

[INLINE + publicRead] Filesystem isolation and immutable catalog/source integrity: candidate/crates/mori/tests/native_feature_boundary.rs (sha256 3c7906963f0798b044b187140780826802292af11f3f0e279558a92f8073563b, prospectiveTree 57d8064415e943ee0ca1ccd879d8cc097c4a3295, formatterCheckExit 0) preserves all 27 CATALOG.json cases (sha256 b8fff83923e3efe2e055b578159744dc7133a1567b278ab67c6bcaea806581e5), runs every child process with current_dir set to an owned TempRoot guard, and asserts byte-identical BTreeMap directory snapshots before and after each invocation. All production files under candidate/crates/mori/src/ remain identical to base main commit 63c38d05b0801b2c919ffe56b2e59c54a86594ac (tree 23a78098cbdf690ac3b6f9a994f6d5033b869b18).

[INLINE + publicRead] Eligibility of new single 90s+5s execution attempt sequence 2: Prior attempt 1 is preserved immutably in failed-attempt-1/{START,CHILD,RESULT,CLEANUP}.json and {STDOUT,STDERR}.log with its owned temporary root /tmp/doctorwatson-cli-availability-check-zpj1mxlq removed and its allocation marked consumed. PROPOSAL.json requests a new attempt sequence 2 (attemptLimit 1, nativeAuthority 0) justified by the R3 test normalizer source fix, executing offline (--frozen, CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true) with -j1 and --test-threads=1 under a 90s TERM + 5s KILL timeout, fresh owned cwd/target/cargo-home/tmp directories, a strict 13-variable environment whitelist without HOME or inherited variables, 4 SHA-256 pinned tool binaries (TOOL-METADATA.json), and 14 verified-absent ancestor Cargo config paths (CARGO-CONFIG-METADATA.json).
limitations: Unchanged directory tree snapshots, sentinel preservation, and error precedence combined with static source audit do NOT prove the absence of read-only syscalls (such as open/stat) by the child process; no strace or filesystem I/O interposition seam is used.

In prior failed attempt 1, only the initial child invocations in each of the 2 test functions executed before panicking on the miette continuation gutter; the full sequence of 44 planned child invocations has not yet been executed and requires post-execution result audit after attempt 2 runs.

Because crates/mori/tests/native_feature_boundary.rs is gated by #![cfg(not(feature = "native"))], default/native builds select 0 tests from this file (which is not a pass for no-native availability), and this single-target --no-default-features command does not rerun the 12 native-gated CLI integration test targets or workspace default/native/fmt/clippy/U/M/MC/SP/G suites.

PROPOSAL.json bounds wall time (90s + 5s kill grace), Cargo jobs (-j1), and test threads (1), and cleans up the owned temporary root immediately after execution, but does not enforce or claim an OS-level aggregate child memory, disk, or process-group resource limit.

The installed local Rust toolchain/timeout binaries, system linker/libraries, public Cargo registry/git dependency stores, and selected non-native build scripts/proc-macros are part of the declared compilation TCB assumption.
